format: NDCA Sanctioned Pro/Am events, multiple competitions on the floor

source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: In Pro/Am events with multiple competitions danced at the same time, at most eight couples may be judged at once; a floor may be split into 'ballrooms' each judged separately with a maximum of eight couples, no ballroom smaller than 1,080 square feet; after a late registration or entry change that would exceed eight, up to ten couples may be on the floor if at least two entries are uncontested.

requirement: An NDCA Pro/Am profile must enforce the eight-couples-judged-at-once limit, the split-floor conditions and the late-entry exception, scoped to Pro/Am events with multiple competitions danced at the same time.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. A PROFILE-ACTIVATION BLOCKER for the named body's scoring profile. Docs-only record; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: planner, SQL, UI changes.
interpretation_notes: This is a floor and judging-load rule for Pro/Am, NOT the Final cap in IV.C.2 ('No more than eight (8) couples shall dance in any Final Round'); the IV.C.1.f / IV.C.2 conflict stays UNRESOLVED in PR 839 (OD09-NDCA-0004). Studio's default capacity of 8 coincides numerically but is a product default (OD25-DF-0001) and does not implement the split-floor area condition or the late-entry exception. 'Uncontested' is not defined in the text read; see OD-21 (PR 847) for single-couple handling.
